basis: Current HeadCalc treats TRIDAG as the normal primary Newton linear solve and enters the banded solver only when TRIDAG returns nonzero ierror.
Official SWAP 4.3.1 SWAP/tridag.f90 contains TRIDAG, bandec and banbks; the official Linux compile script explicitly compiles tridag.f90 and headcalc.f90.
The current SWAP5 src/legacy/b1_10_port postimage contains no production tridag.f90. Existing isolated linksets obtain TRIDAG/bandec/banbks from test fixtures.
The legacy TRIDAG arithmetic depends on MOD_arrays only to dimension local gamma scratch. No physical state or I/O dependency is required by the algorithm.
The current Reference workspace is worker-owned and already contains band fallback scratch, so the linear solve can be made explicit without per-column persistent scratch.

Current HeadCalc fallback calls pass legacy np=macp while fsi_ws%band_matrix is allocated (active_nodes,3). This inherited leading-dimension contract is not safe to assume for compact worker storage when active_nodes differs from macp.

rejected_paths.A_exact_legacy_file_as_is: REJECTED_AS_PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE because it retains MOD_arrays/macp scratch sizing and an implicit external-symbol dependency instead of the worker-owned Reference solver seam.
rejected_paths.C_band_fallback_as_primary: REJECTED_WITHOUT_SEPARATE_POLICY_QUALIFICATION because HeadCalc and legacy theory explicitly define it as rare-case fallback after TRIDAG failure.

selected_minimal_design.headcalc_policy: HeadCalc retains primary-then-fallback choice, warning semantics and alternative_solver_calls diagnostics.
selected_minimal_design.workspace_change: Add one worker-owned tridag_gamma(active_nodes) scratch vector; keep existing band_matrix, band_aux, band_rhs and band_pivots worker-owned.
selected_minimal_design.primary_arithmetic: Preserve legacy TRIDAG operation order, small=0.3d-37 threshold and ierror codes 1000 / 1000+i.
selected_minimal_design.fallback_arithmetic: Preserve legacy bandec/banbks algorithm and pivoting semantics while deriving actual workspace leading dimensions from array shapes rather than legacy macp.
selected_minimal_design.dependency_rule: No MOD_arrays/macp, filesystem, calendar, physical-state or global runtime dependency inside the new linear solver module.

qualification_requirements: Direct differential oracle: new reference_tridag versus archived SWAP 4.3.1 TRIDAG for successful matrices and both failure classes.
Direct differential oracle: new reference_band_solve versus archived bandec+banbks on deterministic tridiagonal matrices including active_nodes values different from legacy macp assumptions.
F-SI18 convergence-control regression must use the production candidate linear solver, not zero-step fixture routines.
No production/reference changes outside the smallest solver/workspace/HeadCalc seam.
Independent F-VQ admission is required before PE may treat higher-cost accepted routes as physical Reference tail evidence.
claim_boundary: This owner decision authorizes a candidate implementation. It does not yet qualify the new linear-solver postimage or admit any F-PE performance fixture.
